title: The Joke Waiting until They Arrived
youtube_title: The Joke Waiting until They Arrived | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A game is kinder when nobody has to watch from the step.
summary: At a library rug under the round window, Gio is just outside the fun, close to a joke you did not tell until your friend was there to hear it. Remy changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Gio has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Grandma Nia lets the children solve it.
